title: New tools will let you edit and invent spoken words
content: Adobe recently gave a sneak peak ofnew software called #VoCowith an amazing (and potentially alarming) capacity to edit recorded speech.Users will easily be able to change word order and even to invent new words using a simple keyboard interface. Novel words can be generated if you have a database of about 20 minutes of recorded speech to draw from.  (Link to YouTube).A few implications:1. Fake news stories with manufactured quotes will be easy to create.2. Human voice actors won't be need to read an entire recorded book or to voice every line for an animated film, especially for low budget productions.3. Adding voices in ADR to the sound edit of a film will be much easier.
